Manual Windows 10/11 notification banner, sound, real click and trusted input remain outside this automated result.

scope: Actual isolated native WebKit and macOS Electron, real file persistence and XLSX export, synthetic date/checkbox/keyboard input and injected save failure. Final node-input CSS was used by editor-polish, node-review, planning, unified-editor, editor-addition, content and readability; six other suites use identical final JavaScript before only that node-input edge/height styling. Screenshots show completed endpoints. No trusted IME, actual OS notification banner/sound/click, held-drag focus loss or user aesthetic acceptance claim.
diagnostics: Native app launched inside the shell sandbox exited without reports; isolated suites passed with required native-app execution permission.
An initial npm invocation omitted the Node runtime from child-process PATH; corrected PATH ran all 54 tests.
Long-content assertions were updated to require the complete type plus hostname and complete cross-year dates plus inclusive duration, retaining clipping and tooltip checks.
Independent XLSX probe initially inspected the node-identity column as a date; corrected to locate the node-date column by its actual header, confirming all 11 typed dates.
